finalText:
I tightened the spacing in the features section. I checked it in a render, and the three cards still look right.

- **Section:** bottom padding is 48 (was 64) and the gap between cards is 12 (was 16).
- **Cards:** inner padding is 16 (was 24) and the gap between title and body is 4 (was 8).

All of these values come from your spacing tokens. If that's more than you wanted, the card padding is the biggest change, and I can put it back to 24.
